description: Request composed saved changes from the native change-history store for a thread.

callerThreadId.description: Restrict review to edits made by one member of the selected family.

includeExternal.description: Include non-ephemeral changes outside the workspace root (default false for Saved Diff).

itemId.description: Read one execution's exact captured effects, not the composed session diff.

limit.description: Page size for composed files. Omit to read a complete review.

perCapture.description: Return individual captures, rather than composing them by file.

receiptItemIds.description: Read per-capture file metadata (no patch text) for these command items in the selected thread only. External and ephemeral files are omitted.

title: ThreadChangesReadParams
